limitations.quote: // Reuse the final zero as the first bit of a possible next match.
limitations.note: The agent fixed the duplicate state encoding but also changed the post-match transitions to reuse the final zero, enabling overlapping matches that the original FSM and reference do not report.
The test's sliding-window oracle expected overlapping matches, so it passed the rewrite without checking whether the original post-match behavior was preserved.
